# JagDroid v0.62-experimental

- Phase Zero: enemies no longer have a blue box around them, and the ground is now desert-coloured instead of solid blue. The blitter's add mode now adds colour bytes as well as intensity, so a source colour of 0 keeps the destination's colour.
- Side effects of the same fix: Arena Football '95's red tint is gone (the pitch is green again) and Zero 5's briefing no longer has a blue block.
